The clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted: venue_bid_time reads 15:22:49.192Z against a local 11:22 ET, confirming the -4 EDT offset.

entryWatch.setup: TGT post-earnings DAY-2 continuation off the 8/19 gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - the candidate this board named IN ADVANCE yesterday, specified today at a 159.36 limit for 2 shares
entryWatch.trigger: ARMED, RE-QUOTED AT 11:22 AND CONFIRMED LIVE UNTIL 15:30 ET - BUT IT HAS STOPPED BEING MARKETABLE AND THE HONEST HEADLINE IS THAT THE FILL GOT HARDER, NOT EASIER. TGT is 159.26 bid / 159.44 ask at 15:22:49.192Z, last trade 159.34, a 0.18 spread or 0.113% of mark - the tightest this name has quoted all session - against the 159.00 official settled close, so it is +0.16% on the bid and 0.44 ABOVE the 158.82 bid the entry was struck on at 09:47. THE 159.36 LIMIT NOW SITS INSIDE THE SPREAD: 0.10 above the 159.26 bid and 0.08 below the 159.44 offer. An order entered now RESTS - it does not fill on entry, which it did at 10:24 when the offer was 159.19 and the limit was 0.17 through it. That window has closed and this row says so rather than repeating last hour's sentence. What has to happen for it to fill is one 0.08 tick down in the offer, and the tape has crossed this level in both directions repeatedly: the session has run 154.58 to 161.28 and the last nine five-minute bars have straddled 159.36 in six of them. BOTH INVALIDATIONS ARE UNTOUCHED. The early warning is a trade below 154.58, today's opening-bar low; nothing has traded below it since, and the lowest low of the twelve bars since the 10:24 check is 157.965, leaving the bid 4.68 or 2.94% clear. The outright void is a close below 152.48, 6.78 below the bid and untestable before the bell. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED. An hourly reading this at 12:17 needs only the tape and three numbers: 159.36, 154.58 and the 15:30 expiry.
entryWatch.why: CONFIRMED RATHER THAN KILLED, AND THIS HOUR THE KILL TEST IS EASIER THAN LAST HOUR'S RATHER THAN HARDER - WHICH IS WORTH STATING BECAUSE THE FILL PROSPECT MOVED THE OTHER WAY. A specification dies when its invalidation triggers, when its limit is no longer inside the spread, or when the setup it described has left the tape. Limb one fails: 154.58 has not been retested and the bid is 2.94% above it. Limb two fails PLAINLY for the first time today - 159.36 IS inside 159.26/159.44, word for word, where at 10:24 it sat outside the spread on the marketable side and the limb had to be argued through. The test that needed a paragraph an hour ago now needs one line. Limb three fails: the level quoted on both sides right now is the level the entry was reasoned on, and the day-2 structure - gap down, shake out to 154.58, reclaim - is intact with the name at a session-long equilibrium rather than trending away. THE COUNTERWEIGHT IS THAT EXECUTION PROBABILITY FELL AND NO RULE LETS THIS RUN FIX THAT. At 10:24 the operator could have filled at 159.19 for 318.38; now the same order rests at 159.36 and needs the offer to come to it. Eight cents of limit would restore the fill. Those eight cents are exactly the raise the rulebook forbids, and the smallness of the number is the argument FOR the rule rather than against it - a discipline that only binds when it is expensive is not a discipline. IT IS ALSO NOT LOWERED. The 159.36 stands as written for the fourth consecutive reading, and the operator is told plainly that it is a resting order now, not a fill.

entryWatch.setup: SQM post-earnings day-2 continuation off a 13% beat with a deliberately tepid day-1 reaction - ranked second today and passed over on liquidity
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 11:22 AND IT IS NOW OUTRUNNING THE NAME THAT WAS BOUGHT - RECORDED BECAUSE THE UNCOMFORTABLE HALF IS THE HALF THAT GRADES THE DECISION. SQM is 77.61 bid / 77.90 ask at 15:22:40.162Z, last 77.665, +2.96% against the 75.38 settled close, against TGT's +0.16% on the same tape at the same instant. The second-ranked name has added two full points of relative performance in one hour. The 0.29 spread is 0.373% of mark against TGT's 0.113% - still three times wider, still the liquidity gap it was ranked second on, and that gap has not narrowed just because the price ran.
entryWatch.why: IT IS NOT CHASED, AND THE REASON IS THE RULEBOOK RATHER THAN THE RANKING. This slot is exits-only, the bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's by design, and the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text - it was discharged at 09:47. Even if this were the open slot, item 2 now refuses it more firmly than at 09:47: a name up 2.96% on day 2, quoted 1.36 above the 76.27 day-2 high the open recorded, is being bought after the move rather than on the reclaim. The whole reason TGT was taken was that it had faded back to its own strike; SQM has done the opposite. KEPT VISIBLE SO THE RETRO CAN GRADE THE PREFERENCE HONESTLY. If SQM finishes ahead of TGT today, the open's ranking was wrong on outcome and right on process, and the record should be able to say both. Passing over a name that then runs is the ordinary cost of ranking on liquidity, not evidence the ranking was mistaken.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings continuation - the thesis this board specified on 8/18 and again on 8/19, both expired unexecuted, now broken on its own written level
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND THIS HOUR THE REFUSAL IS PAYING RATHER THAN MERELY HOLDING. AS is 32.55 bid / 32.57 ask at 15:22:51.724Z, last 32.56, -4.32% against the 34.02 settled close and down another 0.50 in the hour since the 10:24 read. That is 1.15 BELOW the 33.70 early warning the 8/19 entry wrote in advance, and 1.32 below the 33.87 limit that expired unexecuted. THE CHEAPER PRICE IS NOT A REPAIRED THESIS, and each hour it gets cheaper makes that easier to say rather than harder.
entryWatch.why: IT IS NOT RE-STRUCK CHEAPER AND THE RECORD NOW SHOWS WHAT THAT REFUSAL WAS WORTH. The 33.87 limit that expired unfilled yesterday is 1.32 above today's offer. Had this board revived the level when the name first came back to it, the position would be through its own written invalidation and heading for the 8% stop. The higher low the day-2 thesis rested on broke, so a cheaper entry is not a better entry into the same setup - it is an entry into a setup that no longer exists. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away; the mirror rule is that a level may not be revived because the name came back to it after the structure broke. Two sessions of this name declining through a dead level is the cleanest evidence this board has produced that the mirror rule is not merely symmetrical bookkeeping.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, now ABOVE its dead limit for the first time
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED FOR A TWENTIETH TIME AND THE PRICE HAS NOW WALKED BACK THROUGH THE DEAD LIMIT IN THE OTHER DIRECTION. SMCI is 36.08 bid / 36.10 ask at 15:22:52.452Z, last 36.0813, -1.37% against the 36.58 settled close - a 1.35 reversal in one hour from the +2.32% it showed at 10:24. The dead 38.24 limit is now 2.14 ABOVE the offer, having been 0.78 below it an hour ago. The name went from marketable-and-refused to not-marketable-at-all inside a single hourly window.
entryWatch.why: THE PRICE COMING BACK WAS NEVER THE CATALYST RETURNING, AND ONE HOUR SUPPLIED THE PROOF. At 10:24 this row said a lower price has never supplied the catalyst item 1 wanted; at 11:22 the higher price it was refusing has evaporated too. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5 - no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now seven sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet - and a +3.91% morning that becomes a -1.37% midday repairs neither. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 2026-08-19 to 2026-08-26 calendar. It keeps its place on the board for liquidity alone, on the tightest quote here at 0.055%, and is passed over for a name whose item 1 passes on a print one session old.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 3 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 11:22 AND STILL WITHOUT THE ONE THING IT HAS NEVER HAD. KLAR is 14.07 bid / 14.09 ask at 15:22:50.776Z, last 14.09, -4.48% against the 14.73 settled close and a further 0.12 below the 10:24 read - a third consecutive down day, now well through the 14.32 level this row carried, grinding rather than basing. A base is the precondition any entry here would need and none has formed in three sessions of trying.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT, and the four-beats-four-sell-offs tape it was recorded against this morning has if anything got louder. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18; three sessions on, AS is -4.3% today and KLAR is -4.5% on top of -22.5%. Neither beat is paying. WMT beat this morning and sold off, AAP beat by 27% and lost a fifth of the company. That is the whole argument for reading a catalyst together with positioning rather than counting it on its own - and it is the argument this hour's TGT confirmation is resting against, which is why it stays in front of the operator rather than being pruned as noise.
